name: v2.5.0 — Connections
body:
### Added

- Connect a **PaymentsCo** account from the Connections page in two clicks
- Jobs created by phone now appear in the connected account automatically
- Added support for per-workspace connection limits ([#814](https://github.com/acme/webapp/pull/814))

### Fixed

- Fixed a crash when opening Connections with no account linked (#812)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/acme/webapp/compare/v2.4.0...v2.5.0
